title: monardella villosa subsp. subserrata
intro: Monardella villosa subsp. subserrata, commonly known as Purple Mountain Monardella, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Monardella villosa subsp. subserrata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to help alleviate symptoms associated with colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
